1.

O Jesus, Thy name is a fortress in distress, Our staff and our stay and our mountain-firm stronghold, Thy name is the surest antidote against death, Oh, knew but, oh, knew but all the world it!

2.

Thy name is a poured-out ointment that heals And soothes and restores the wounded soul; Thy name is our strength, a power that does not fail; Thy name is our refuge in woe and in weal.

3.

Thy name is a rock in the hour of trial, A tower which none can cast down, A light that dispels the thickest of mists, A spring that gives us living water.

4.

Thy name has proved also upon my heart The life-power that lies hidden therein, And stilled my unrest and eased my pain, And made me free from the terror of death.

5.

Well may we the glorious name extol, O Jesus, as long as we await Thee here, And then for eternity with heart and tongue Proclaim how great and how worthy it is.
